title: Missing Number
summary: An array holds n distinct numbers from the range 0 to n. Find the one that is missing.

tests.explain: There are 4 numbers, so the range is 0 to 4. Only 2 is absent.
The range is 0 to 3, and 3 itself is the missing one.
The range is 0 to 1, so the missing number is 0.

hints: There are n + 1 candidates (0 to n) and n numbers, so exactly one candidate is absent. A Set works, but uses O(n) memory.
If you XOR every candidate 0..n together with every value in nums, each present number appears twice. What happens to it?
Start with result = n, then for each index i do result ^= i ^ nums[i]. Everything cancels except the missing number. (The sum formula n(n + 1) / 2 minus the array's sum also works.)
